fetch_prs_since_tag: fetch all PRs merged since a git tag and save them as JSON files to the output directory
extract_pr_number: extract a PR number from a squash-merge commit message using the format (\(#1234\))
fetch_pr_details: fetch full PR details including title, author, labels, merged date, and doc diffs for a given PR number
fetch_doc_diffs: extract diffs for markdown files under docs/ from a GitHub PR as a list of filename, status, and patch dicts
get_commits_since_tag: get all commits between a git tag and HEAD on the main branch for a GitHub repository
